entities.summary: Alberto César Mancini is a former professional tennis player from Argentina. He won three top-level singles titles and four tour doubles titles. His career-high rankings were World No. 8 in singles and No. 79 in doubles. Alberto Mancini was a athletes & competitors from Posadas (b. 1969-05-20, Posadas). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
